name: Low Cable Single-Arm Bicep Curl
description: The low cable single-arm curl uses a low cable pulley with a single handle to curl one arm at a time. The cable provides constant tension from the bottom position through the full arc of the curl, maintaining resistance at full elbow flexion where free weights go slack. Training each arm independently allows the lifter to focus on the working side and address strength imbalances between arms.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing the low cable pulley. Grasp a single handle with one hand in a supinated grip. Arm extended toward the pulley.
execution.setup_instructions: Set the low cable pulley with a single handle attachment. Stand one step back from the stack.
steps: Step 1: Begin with the arm extended down toward the pulley, elbow at the side.
Step 2: Curl the forearm upward by flexing the elbow, keeping the upper arm stationary.
Step 3: Curl until maximum elbow flexion is reached.
Step 4: Return slowly to the starting extended position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Elbow drifting forward during the curl
Not supinating the grip at the top
safety_considerations: Keep the shoulder down and relaxed
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension to maximum elbow flexion.
coaching_cues: Elbow stays glued to the side
